title: Production deployment + versioned exports + disclaimer/attribution/branding
context: The M3 production deployment makes the directory and its open exports publicly available over HTTPS. Key requirements: a visible disclaimer that the dataset is community-maintained and not an official agency product unless a named partner endorses it; 'last verified / call ahead' framing on every entry; versioned export bundles for downstream reusers; correct attribution including OSM. Depends on food-maps-a11y-014 (accessible view) and food-maps-export-013 (open exports).
objective: Deploy the food-assistance-maps directory view and open export bundles to a static production hosting environment (HTTPS). The deployment must include: (1) a visible disclaimer on the site and in export bundles stating the dataset is community-maintained and not an official agency product; (2) 'last verified / call ahead' framing on every entry in the view; (3) versioned export bundles (semantic versioning, checksummed) accessible at stable URLs; (4) correct attribution/credits page (OSM, all sources, map-tile provider); and (5) a documented deployment and release process.
acceptanceCriteria: Directory view is deployed to a static hosting environment over HTTPS (e.g. GitHub Pages, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages)
Visible disclaimer present on every page: the dataset is community-maintained and is not an official agency product unless a named partner has endorsed it
Every entry in the view displays last_verified and a 'call ahead / verify before visiting' caveat
Export bundles are versioned with semantic versioning, named with version tags (e.g. v1.0.0), and available at stable URLs
Export bundles include checksums (SHA-256) for integrity verification
A credits/attribution page or section lists all data sources with correct attribution strings, including '© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL' if OSM data is included
Deployment process is documented: how to cut a release, update exports, and push to production
The site's TLS certificate is valid and the deployment passes a basic security check (no mixed content, CSP headers present)
CI/CD pipeline produces production builds and deployment artifacts on tagged releases
output: Deployed production site at a stable HTTPS URL + CI/CD release pipeline producing versioned, checksummed export bundles + docs/deployment.md (release process documentation).
